description: An open-source UI component library for building high-quality, accessible design systems and web apps for Vue. Previously Radix Vue

latest_release.name: v2.12.0
latest_release.body:
###    🚀 Features

- **Carousel**:
  - Add primitives  -  by @benjamincanac and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/3262 [<samp>(65d80)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/65d8012a1)
- **Checkbox**:
  - Adding nested parent checkbox  -  by @lepture and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2073 [<samp>(39eb8)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/39eb8baca)
- **Combobox**:
  - Add a clearValue factory for the value to reset to on clear  -  by @yan-ad and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2734 [<samp>(7d9fb)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/7d9fb8ee3)
  - Add `focusOnOpen` to keep focus off the input on open  -  by @zernonia, @kricsleo and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/3326 [<samp>(ffb2c)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/ffb2cbc62)
  - Add `max` prop to limit selected options  -  by @kricsleo and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/1922 [<samp>(cbc19)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/cbc191d3e)
- **ConfigProvider**:
  - Translatable accessible labels  -  by @zernonia and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/3418 [<samp>(7c562)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/7c562b8b9)
- **Dialog**:
  - Add a style hook for dialogs below an open nested dialog  -  by @zernonia and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/3407 [<samp>(fd127)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/fd1273e25)
- **DropdownMenu, Menubar, ContextMenu**:
  - Support `unmountOnHide`  -  by @zernonia, @kricsleo and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/3324 [<samp>(87e2a)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/87e2ad568)
- **Listbox**:
  - Highlight an item without moving focus  -  by @zernonia and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/3300 [<samp>(bc393)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/bc39365f1)
  - Add `keepFocusOnValueChange` to keep focus on programmatic value changes  -  by @zernonia, @kricsleo and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/3325 [<samp>(60b60)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/60b60995c)
- **NumberField**:
  - Add keepValueOnUnparsableInput to keep the value when committed input cannot be parsed  -  by @61021 and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/3024 [<samp>(81345)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/813458613)
- **PinInput**:
  - Support opt-in complete PIN validation  -  by @shuvroroy and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/3307 [<samp>(5c8be)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/5c8bea202)
- **Popover**:
  - Support `unmountOnHide`  -  by @kricsleo and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2066 [<samp>(24cc6)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/24cc6d65f)
- **Popper**:
  - Add an opt-in fallback to perpendicular sides on collisions  -  by @sean0407 and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/3011 [<samp>(7721b)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/7721b0f15)
- **ScrollArea**:
  - Add virtualizer  -  by @yan-ad and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2775 [<samp>(34b8c)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/34b8cf339)
- **SliderArea**:
  - Add SliderArea component  -  by @GrandMagus02 and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2460 [<samp>(67b26)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/67b2690fe)
- **Stepper**:
  - Localize announcements and use step positions  -  by @minwookshin and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unovue/rek
